# Vendored security packages

These packages temporarily close publicly disclosed dependency vulnerabilities while patched releases are unavailable from the public npm registry. Each archive comes from an immutable upstream release tag and is pinned as a direct dependency so npm overrides can safely reference it with `$dependency`.

## `brace-expansion-5.0.8.tgz`

Official npm package tarball generated from upstream tag `v5.0.8` (`96a63c0011c0288846ad41773c73e3fbd0906b59`).

- Upstream: `https://github.com/juliangruber/brace-expansion`
- Fix: CVE-2026-14257 / GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg
- SHA-256: `0d089af987938109a964ad09ecf0977c3c6fdd7469f6183be7766ebad0858ce1`

## `brace-expansion-5.0.8-compat.tgz`

Deterministic derivative of `brace-expansion-5.0.8.tgz` used by the frontend. Its only content change is an exact suffix on `dist/commonjs/index.js` that restores the callable CommonJS export expected by legacy Minimatch consumers. The ESM API and all expansion logic remain byte-for-byte identical to upstream.

- Build recipe: `python scripts/build_brace_expansion_compat.py`
- Verification: `python scripts/build_brace_expansion_compat.py --check`
- SHA-256: `3d2d5a992096e7faf5c8271dc457fb6f77b200ae8218c1255fffce5fc6b20467`

`scripts/verify_vendored_packages.py` verifies both archives and rejects any compatibility delta beyond that approved suffix.

## `js-yaml-4.3.0.tgz`

Release package generated from upstream tag `4.3.0` (`33d05b5d29a8c21360f620f7e1c1706e24522eda`). The committed archive includes the ESM distribution generated by the release's pinned build toolchain.

- Upstream: `https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml`
- Fix: merge-key denial of service
- SHA-256: `d7cc333d5361acfcb551e1279e090326b4e3dbe4831059aa85dc85b401a2e8c8`

## `nanoid-3.3.16.tgz`

Release package generated from verified signed tag `3.3.16` (`9760e112757cf7d46a79abd7a133bc4958757bb8`). PostCSS 8.5.20 requires this patched version.

- Upstream: `https://github.com/ai/nanoid`
- Fix: infinite loop for negative non-secure ID sizes
- SHA-256: `7b1def0fea02c173bd29096bc22737ba517471b6cca361cdba2b05c74676649e`

## `postcss-8.5.20.tgz`

Release package generated from upstream annotated tag `8.5.20` (`c4ac725d5920916d35be44002b49b7f66f8b1dc8`).

- Upstream: `https://github.com/postcss/postcss`
- Fix: source map path traversal
- SHA-256: `106e5ae35933848f8912f3395c17952a72867cf88c28176efc773f1ffeb87590`

## Removal policy

Replace each file dependency with its public-registry release and remove its archive once that exact or newer patched version is published, parent-tool compatibility is verified, and clean-install audits remain green. Remove the upstream and compatibility brace-expansion archives together once legacy Minimatch consumers support the patched registry release without adaptation.
